meta.title: Bidri Crafts — store demo
meta.description: Demo of the Bidri Crafts WooCommerce store. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is saved and no real payments are taken.
meta.author: arunkumarpatil24j2007-cmd

options.blogdescription: Authentic GI-certified Bidriware, handmade in Bidar

steps.data:
<?php
// Demo only: photos are already web-sized, so skip generating resized copies (saves browser memory).
add_filter( 'intermediate_image_sizes_advanced', '__return_empty_array' );
add_filter( 'big_image_size_threshold', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'woocommerce_background_image_regeneration', '__return_false' );
// Demo only: the first visit to WooCommerce's welcome page opens Studio instead (the owner panel).
add_action( 'admin_init', function () {
	if ( 'wc-admin' === ( $_GET['page'] ?? '' ) && empty( $_GET['path'] ) && empty( $_COOKIE['bidri_demo_seen'] ) ) {
		setcookie( 'bidri_demo_seen', '1', 0, '/' );
		wp_safe_redirect( admin_url( 'admin.php?page=bidri-studio' ) );
		exit;
	}
}, 1 );

options.woocommerce_demo_store_notice: Demo store — browse freely. Orders here are not real and no money is taken.

woocommerce_cod_settings.description: In the live store this step is Razorpay: UPI, cards and netbanking.

steps.code:
<?php
define( 'BIDRI_LIGHT_MEDIA', true );
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_CLI' ) ) { class WP_CLI { static function log( $m ) {} static function warning( $m ) { error_log( $m ); } static function success( $m ) {} } }
$args = array( '/wordpress/bidri-demo' );
require '/wordpress/bidri-demo/lib/import.php';
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
flush_rewrite_rules();
// Demo: three sample orders so Studio has something to show.
$mk = function ( $items, $name, $status, $note = '' ) {
	$o = wc_create_order();
	foreach ( $items as $sku => $q ) { $p = wc_get_product( wc_get_product_id_by_sku( $sku ) ); if ( $p ) { $o->add_product( $p, $q ); } }
	[ $f, $l ] = explode( ' ', $name, 2 );
	$a = array( 'first_name' => $f, 'last_name' => $l, 'address_1' => '12 MG Road', 'city' => 'Bengaluru', 'state' => 'KA', 'postcode' => '560001', 'country' => 'IN', 'phone' => '9876543210', 'email' => strtolower( $f ) . '@example.com' );
	$o->set_address( $a, 'billing' ); $o->set_address( $a, 'shipping' );
	$o->set_payment_method( 'cod' ); $o->set_payment_method_title( 'Demo payment' ); $o->set_customer_note( $note );
	$o->calculate_totals(); $o->set_date_paid( time() ); $o->save();
	$o->update_status( $status );
};
$mk( array( 'BC-DEC-003' => 1 ), 'Priya Sharma', 'completed', 'Happy Diwali, Amma! With love, Priya' );
$mk( array( 'BC-DEC-001' => 1, 'BC-DEC-005' => 1 ), 'Rahul Verma', 'processing' );
$mk( array( 'BC-DEC-004' => 1 ), 'Ananya Iyer', 'processing', 'Please gift wrap' );
// Demo: no WooCommerce welcome/onboarding redirect.
delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array( 'skipped' => true, 'completed' => true ) );
update_option( 'woocommerce_task_list_hidden', 'yes' );
